content_sections.heading: GBPIHED Senior Project Fellow Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available under the in-house project-03 titled "Fostering Socio-Ecological Security and Sustainable Bio economy in the Indian Himalayan Region through Community-Driven Block chain Governance Models".

content_sections.text: Visit the official online recruitment portal at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php . Ensure you meet all essential qualifications and eligibility criteria before applying. Fill out the online application form with the required details. Upload necessary documents and submit the application. Ensure final submission is completed on or before 23 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Take a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through the online recruitment portal only on or before 11:59 PM on 23rd October 2026. Candidates appearing for the physical interview must bring original documents pertaining to educational qualifications and experience along with one set of photocopies. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPIHED), Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for GBPIHED Recruitment Advt No. NIHE/HQ-19/26-27?
faq.answer: The post name is Senior Project Fellow (SPF).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 23rd October 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Master degree in relevant subjects (such as Remote Sensing & GIS, Environmental Science, Computer Science, Data Science, etc.) with two years of research experience, or a Ph.D. in the relevant subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 28,000/- +HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be short-listed and informed separately about the mode, date, and time of the interview.
